create_rag_corpus: create a Vertex AI RAG corpus with a display name, optional description, and vector database config
store_file_to_corpus: store a file into a Vertex AI RAG corpus, returning the rag corpus ID and file ID
upload_file_to_corpus: upload a file to a Vertex AI RAG corpus using multipart upload with optional chunking config
import_files_from_gcs: import files from Google Cloud Storage URIs into a Vertex AI RAG corpus
poll_operation: poll a Vertex AI long-running operation until it completes or times out
